svg.title: A comfortable room has places to sit, light and plants.
svg.text: A comfortable room has places to sit, light and plants.

text.tspan: I like to arrange a room. Two small things help me.
First, We put our keys by the door. We can find them in the morning.
Next, We put a photo on the wall. We like looking at it.
These two things help us. We can arrange a room and enjoy our time together.
BUILD YOUR OWN · State a focused main idea. Develop one supporting reason in each body paragraph, with a concrete example. Conclude by connecting the two
reasons without introducing a new argument. Use the structure as a model; write about an experience of your own.
Your example. What two reasons support the main idea? Explain one example.
